input.title: Lakeshore Staffing — candidate source tracking
input.summary: Hyun Kim reported that placements are up but the job boards that produce hires are unknown. The group agreed on one required source field for every candidate record. Recruiters still need to be told about the field before it goes live.
decisions: Use one required source field on every candidate record.

actionItems.task: Map current source values and send the cleanup list
actionItems.quote: I'll map the current source values and send the cleanup list by November 12.

actionItems.task: Make the source field required on the intake form
actionItems.quote: I'll update the intake form so the source field is required.

actionItems.task: Tell the recruiters about the new field before it goes live
actionItems.quote: Somebody needs to tell the recruiters about the new field before it goes live.

actionItems.task: Pull last year's placement numbers by job board
actionItems.quote: I'll pull last year's placement numbers by job board, if the data is there.

followUp.subject: Candidate source tracking: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Hyun and Grace,

Thanks for the time today. We agreed on one required source field for every candidate record.

I will map the current source values and send the cleanup list by November 12. Someone still needs to tell the recruiters about the new field before it goes live; let me know who should own that.

Best,
Casey
